data.description: Authorization to import specimens or their parts from one country to another.

Authorization to conduct research within a permitted jurisdiction. Usually also requires additional permits (e.g., collect, export). Examples: U.S. Forest Service research permit; Memorandum of Understanding; Convenio.
Authorization to possess animals, provide rehabilitative care, transport to other facility, release or euthanize, and dispose of dead specimens.
Authorization to collect and possess specimens or their parts (e.g., blood, feather samples).
Authorization to export specimens or their parts from one country to another.
Authorization to pick up and possess dead animals.

Authorization to transfer specimens from one institution to another within the same country. Example: USDA Transport Permit for restricted materials between US institutions; USFWS authorization to transfer confiscated materials.
Used for transactions under which a permit is explicitly not required. Clarify in permit_remarks.
